title: LACTARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Preparar fórmulas de composições lácteas, hídricas e dietas enterais a serem utilizadas nas diversas clínicas do Hospital, bem como efetuar a higienização de embalagens, bicos, mamadeiras e outros.

Requirements and skills

Ensino Médio completo

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Lactarista

Additional information

Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho x 36 horas de descanso

Horário: 07:00 - 19:00 e/ou 19:00 - 07:00 (folguista)

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

Overview

In this role, you will be the key link between our automation systems and digitalization initiatives, ensuring seamless integration from the shop floor to the cloud. You will work on bridging operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT), deploying secure and robust industrial applications, and enabling data-driven services for our customers. Your expertise in industrial communication protocols, automation infrastructure, and cloud environments will help us deliver cutting-edge solutions that enhance plant performance, improve asset visibility, and enable advanced analytics.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Act as the technical interface between automation engineers, digitalization teams, and IT/cloud specialists.
  • Design, configure, and implement secure connectivity between field devices, control systems, and digital platforms.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain industrial applications both on-premise and in cloud/hybrid environments.
  • Optimize data acquisition, processing, and integration from SCADA/DCS/PLC systems to higher-level digital services.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, networking, and industrial communication standards.
  • Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve data pipelines from sensors to enterprise applications.
  • Support project teams in developing scalable and reliable architectures for condition monitoring, predictive analytics, and performance optimization.

What You Bring

  • Strong background in industrial automation systems (PCS 7, SIMATIC, or similar) and OT infrastructure.
  • In-depth knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Modbus, PROFINET, MQTT).
  • Experience in deploying and configuring industrial applications on physical, virtualized, and cloud-based environments (Azure, AWS, or similar).
  • Proficiency in industrial networking, cybersecurity, and system integration.
  • Hands-on experience with edge computing, gateways, and IoT platforms.
  • Ability to bridge OT and IT requirements, translating operational needs into digital solutions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in multi-disciplinary, international teams.
  • Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

About The Team

Transformation of Industry: Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levar saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil é o nosso propósito. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. The product owner is responsible for the ownership and managing of the backlog for their assigned value stream(s), contributes to the product roadmap, and understands customer and market needs for the PremierOne product. The product owner works in partnership with the product manager and relies on their technical knowledge and background to define user stories and acceptance criteria, engage with assigned Engineering teams, and groom the backlog. The ability to deeply understand technical architecture, define engineering behind features, and translate high-level customer functional requirements into technical for development is a crucial skill. In addition, the ability to describe the impact of technical requirements on customers, non-technical sales, and support resources is a must.

This position will be responsible for filling the agile product owner role for the PremierOne product. In this role, the product owner champions the needs of the user, customer, and other stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure that what is delivered meets the goals, objectives, and desired outcomes of the project. To be successful, one must manage multiple projects simultaneously, at various stages of their development, from idea to completed feature.

description:
Overview

ABOUT US

We’re like-minded, curious, excitable people here at Chiliz who work well in teams, spread across the globe. Chiliz is a global blockchain company, which powers Socios.com - the creators of Fan Tokens, and the popular fan rewards platform.

Socios has partnered with some of the world’s best teams, including Paris Saint-Germain, Juventus, FC Barcelona, Atlético de Madrid, UFC, Galatasaray, Manchester City FC, and many more.

The curious nature of a Chilizen is what drives this company forward, and since we’re looking to grow even more, apply for your dream role today.

OUR BRANDS & CHANNELS

We are building the web3 infrastructure for sports & entertainment!

Founded in 2018, Chiliz is a blockchain provider focused on the sports and entertainment industry. We build scalable, secure blockchain-enabled solutions that supercharge fan experiences using digital assets.

$CHZ is the native digital token for the Chiliz sports & entertainment ecosystem currently powering Socios.com and the Chiliz Chain blockchain.

Socios.com is a fan engagement and rewards app that allows fans to engage with their favourite teams and clubs through digital assets known as Fan Tokens.

The Role

We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships with retail networks, financial institutions, investment firms, and other potential distribution channels for fan tokens and Chiliz products

  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across banking, sports organizations, and crypto-related businesses in Brazil

  • Create compelling business proposals, pitch decks, and partnership frameworks tailored to prospective partners' needs and objectives

  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics in the Brazilian digital asset and sports engagement landscape

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful partnership implementation and ongoing relationship management

  • Represent Socios.com/Chiliz at industry events, conferences, and client meetings

  • Track partnership performance metrics and provide regular reports on business development activities and pipeline status

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or partnerships, preferably within the financial services/banking sector. Preferably knowledge of web3, and could be sports related.

  • Proven track record of successfully closing complex B2B partnerships and achieving revenue targets

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian financial services landscape and regulatory environment

  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills with ability to influence C-level executives

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field

  • Direct experience or demonstrated interest in sports industry partnerships and sponsorships

  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital asset markets

  • Existing network within Brazilian banking, retail, or investment sectors

  • Experience drafting commercial agreements and partnership terms

What We Offer

We offer you the chance to grow, to learn, to flex your creative muscles and to work on a project that is providing excitement to thousands of users.

Our interview phase is a 3-step process where you’ll be able to ask us anything and get to know your team too. From HR right through to your team lead, we need this process to work both ways: It’s not just about you fitting in, but about us being the right fit for you too.

Are you ready to work with the world’s best teams? Are you happy to try, fail and bounce back? Are you excited to keep pushing the boundaries of technology?

We’ve got offices across the world, over 30 nationalities in our ranks and the most important superpower of all - flexibility. Our competitive salaries, wellness allowance, healthcare and pension plan are just the tip of the iceberg. You’ll gain friends, experience and a good challenge, we’ll gain you.

Are you ready?

Responsável pelo planejamento, controle e execução de atividades relacionadas à manutenção e execução de projetos dentro do escopo do departamento de Engenharia de Projetos, a fim de garantir a assistência técnica à Operação e Manutenção de Unidades Offshore, bem como contribuir para a sua disponibilidade e atingimento de resultados, estabelecido para o negócio. Support/Attend on suppliers' contracts, to internal and external clients, audits, and compliance assurance in general

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuação em projetos de extensão da vida útil de FPSO, envolvendo análise de integridade, conformidade regulatória e coordenação multidisciplinar para viabilizar a continuidade operacional da unidade.
  • Contribuir para o atingimento de resultados da Operação, analisando os relatórios de NAM emitidos e atuando com base nas suas informações, desenvolvendo Projetos de Reparo para cada equipamento e acompanhando sua execução, seguindo Normas Internacionais e as diretrizes e filosofias da MODEC, e desenvolvendo/monitorando/analisando KPIs adequados e estatísticas significativas e estabelecendo ações adequadas para eliminar gargalos, promovendo melhoria contínua.
  • Apoiar o Plano POB das embarcações, fornecendo aos AMC's as informações solicitadas sobre soluções de design e planos de trabalho.
  • Manter a disponibilidade dos equipamentos, de acordo com o plano de manutenção, por meio da máxima conformidade, operação e manutenção economicamente rentáveis, elaborando ou prestando suporte à elaboração de RFQs e IHRs para os Projetos de Reparo, bem como validação de POs para a área de Supply Chain, e identificando melhorias de execução e oportunidades de redução de backlog.
  • Apoiar o planejamento orçamentário de despesas e investimentos da MdB para o Departamento de Engenharia de Projetos, fornecendo informações baseadas em experiências anteriores, histórico de manutenção, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas do mercado e mapeando riscos para apoiar decisões de gestão.
  • Agir proativamente para resguardar a MODEC do descumprimento aos requisitos legais/regulatórios e normas técnicas, atendendo a todas as especificações e procedimentos técnicos relativos ao escopo do Departamento de Engenharia de Projetos, atendendo auditorias internas/externas e criando planos de ação para corrigir não conformidades.
  • Garantir alinhamentos técnicos operacionais, participando e organizando, quando solicitado, das reuniões de revisão técnica com o cliente.
  • Proporcionar avaliação técnica adequada de possíveis prestadores de serviços visando a sua pré-qualificação, desenvolvendo um escopo técnico detalhado do trabalho para apoiar a equipe de Compras no processo licitatório, bem como avaliar e aprovar as propostas técnicas para essas licitações. Aprovar tecnicamente as prorrogações contratuais e ser responsável pelo fornecedor contratado seguindo o planejamento, execução e fechamento do serviço e apoiando os AMC's na aprovação de relatórios e BM's.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua do IMS, acompanhando e preenchendo o status dos projetos, e atualizando e monitorando a implementação de documentos do IMS do escopo do departamento de Engenharia de Projetos.
  • Entender e seguir os objetivos da empresa, políticas, procedimentos e integração com clientes, comunidade e fornecedores, lendo documentos relevantes e interagindo com superiores para esclarecimento de possíveis dúvidas.
  • Contribuir para o alinhamento com o cliente em discussões técnicas, apoiando o gestor e os AMC's na interação com representantes e especialistas das SPC's, fornecendo análises técnicas e agregando conhecimento técnico à discussão.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico a todos os Tiers e a outros escritórios da MODEC e unidades a nível mundial, resolvendo problemas ou dúvidas, como por exemplo, respondendo a MOC's, TQ's ou realizando recomendações de RCA's e estudos de segurança mediante solicitação.
  • Contribuir para a captação de lições aprendidas para o desenvolvimento futuro e melhoria dos projetos de EPCI, documentando e elaborando adequadamente relatórios de encerramento sobre questões relacionadas ao escopo de trabalho do departamento de Engenharia de Projetos.
  • Apoiar novos projetos em suas fases de BID, EPCI e Pré-Operações, fornecendo informações técnicas com base na experiência de operações, quando solicitado.

MODEC do BRASIL is hiring a PROJECT ENGINEER to work in our Office , with responsibilities such as:

  • Working on FPSO life extension projects, involving integrity analysis, regulatory compliance, and multidisciplinary coordination to enable the operational continuity of the unit.
  • Contribute to the Operation's results achievement, by analyzing NAM reports issued and acting upon their information, developing Repair Projects for each equipment, and keeping track of its execution, following International Standards and MODEC's guidelines and philosophies, and by developing/monitoring/analyzing proper KPIs and meaningful statistics and by setting adequate actions to eliminate gaps, promoting continuous improvement.
  • Support the vessels' POB Plan, by providing AMCs requested information about solution designs and work plans.
  • Maintain the equipment's availability, according to the maintenance plan, by reaching out for maximum compliance, cost-efficient operation and maintenance, preparing or supporting the preparation of RFQs and IHRs for the Repair Projects, as well as validating POs for Supply Chain area, and identifying execution improvement and backlog reduction opportunities.
  • Support the MdB's expenses and investments budget planning for the Project Engineering Department, by providing information based on previous experiences, maintenance history, technical knowledge, and best practices of the market and by mapping risks to support management decisions.
  • Act proactively to safeguarding MODEC from noncompliance to legal/regulatory requirements and technical standards by meeting all technical specifications and procedures regarding the Project Engineering Department scope, attending internal/external audits, and creating action plans to correct nonconformities.
  • Ensure operational technical alignments, by participating and organizing, when requested, the client's review technical meetings.
  • Provide proper technical evaluation of possible service providers aiming at their pre-qualification, by developing detailed technical scope of the work to support the Procurement team in the bidding process, as well as evaluating and approving the technical proposals for these tenders. Technically approve contract extensions and be the responsible for the contracted supplier by following the planning, execution and closing of the service and supporting AMCs in the approval of reports and BMs.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of IMS by following up and filling in projects status and updating and monitoring the implementation of IMS Documents under Project Engineering department's scope.
  • Understand and follow company objectives, policies, procedures and integration with clients, community, and suppliers, by reading relevant documents and interacting with superiors for clarification of possible doubts.
  • Contribute to the alignment with the client in technical discussions, by supporting the manager and AMCs in the interaction with SPCs representants and specialists, providing technical analyses and adding technical expertise to the discussion.
  • Provide technical support to all Tiers and other MODEC Offices and units worldwide by resolving issues or doubts, as for example, by responding to each MOCs, TQs or performing RCAs and safety studies recommendations upon request.
  • Contribute to the capture of lessons learnt for future development and improvement of EPCI projects, by properly documenting and elaborating close-out reports on issues related to the Project Engineering department scope of work.
  • Support new projects in their BID, EPCI and Pre-Ops phases, by providing technical information based on operations experience, when requested.

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia é obrigatório - Naval, Estrutura ou Mecânica;

description:
Overview

Um retrato do seu dia

Trabalhar como representante da SIEMENS ENERGY junto ao cliente, executando os serviços de assistência técnica remota ou na plataforma quanto requerido, suportando remotamente a equipe offshore (SIEMENS ENERGY e CLIENTE) responsável pela execução das manutenções preditivas, preventivas, corretivas e suporte operacional aos pacotes de Moto e Turbo compressão de gás de fornecimento da SIEMENS ENERGY para o devido projeto.

Como você causará um impacto

  • Prestar suporte as atividades de troubleshooting, análise de falhas em todas as fases de partida, operação, parada dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores. À distância, prestar assistência técnica, auxiliar e orientar as equipes de manutenção da plataforma, durante a execução de rotinas de manutenção programadas ou não, sempre que solicitado;
  • Orientar as equipes do Cliente e Siemens Energy sobre as melhores práticas de manutenção dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores. Auxiliar e prestar suporte na elaboração e/ou revisão de procedimentos padronizados para tarefas de manutenção dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores;
  • Assessorar na elaboração de procedimentos de calibração dos dispositivos de controle e respectivos cartões, detalhando todas as tarefas necessárias;
  • Suportar na obtenção de informações técnicas atualizadas dos equipamentos atendidos pertencentes aos pacotes fornecidos pela Siemens Energy; Suportar desvios em resultados de técnicas de preditiva fornecidos pelo cliente (exemplo: análise de vibrações, desempenho de equipamentos) e propor soluções;
  • Prestar suporte na avaliação da obsolescência e verificar com os fornecedores as possíveis soluções; Propor modificações visando melhorar os equipamentos, sempre que identificada a possibilidade ou ainda que as melhorias sejam através dos boletins emitidos pela contratada;
  • Auxiliar no planejamento dos serviços de manutenção de grande porte (serviços emergenciais ou intervenções planejadas) nos equipamentos pertencentes aos pacotes de geração e compressão.

O que esperamos que você nos traga

  • Graduação em engenharia ou Técnico (Mecânica ou Mecatrônica);
  • Experiência de embarques em contratos de assistência técnica em equipamentos rotativos; comissionamento e/ou troubleshooting em Compressores Centrífugos DATUM Dresser Rand; Capacidade de efetuar troubleshooting remotamente;
  • Suportar remotamente Desmontagem e montagem de compressores centrífugos, turbocompressores e motocompressores; Validar Inspeção visual e dimensional de componentes como mancais, rotores e selos; Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques; Experiência em Instalação e alinhamento de compressores e seus periféricos (gearboxes, VORECONs, sensores);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, junto ao cliente para programar as manutenções offshore; Conhecimento de controle de Surges de compressores.
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Estar alinhado e ativo com os requisitos e diretrizes de HSE, Qualidade e compliance

Sobre a equipe

Nossa equipe é responsável pela execução dos contratos de Assistência técnica, Operações, LTP e outros para os nossos clientes offshore e contamos com um grupo com experiência consolidada nos equipamentos cobertos em nossos contratos.

Quem é a Siemens Energy?

Na Siemens Energy, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa de tecnologia de energia. Atendemos à crescente demanda de energia em mais de 90 países, ao mesmo tempo em que garantimos que nosso clima seja protegido. Com ~100.000 funcionários dedicados, não apenas geramos eletricidade para mais de 16% da comunidade global, mas também usamos nossa tecnologia para ajudar a proteger as pessoas e o meio ambiente.

Nossa equipe global está comprometida em tornar a energia sustentável, confiável e acessível uma realidade, expandindo os limites do que é possível. Mantemos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que apoiarão nosso foco em descarbonização, novas tecnologias e transformação energética.

Confira este vídeo para saber mais sobre a Siemens Energy:

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade

Para nossa sorte, não somos todos iguais. Por meio da diversidade, geramos energia. Funcionamos com inclusão e nossa energia criativa combinada é alimentada por mais de 130 nacionalidades. A Siemens Energy celebra o caráter — não importa a origem étnica, gênero, idade, religião, identidade ou deficiência. Nós energizamos a sociedade, toda a sociedade, e não discriminamos com base em nossas diferenças.

description:
Overview

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Auxiliar na gestão dos contratos e execução das estratégias de Suprimentos, buscando sempre a otimização de custos e a qualidade no atendimento das demandas internas e dos shoppings.
  • Realizar a criação e manutenção dos Acordos com as regras aplicáveis no sistema.
  • Cumprir procedimentos e Políticas de Compras, garantindo o atendimento das metas estabelecidas em SLA.
  • Responder chamados não atendidos nos níveis 0 e 1.
  • Monitorar tendências de mercado e fatores macroeconômicos que afetam os preços (commodities, sazonalidades).
  • Analisar a compra de materiais, equipamentos, matérias-primas e serviços e negociação com fornecedores e monitorar o cumprimento de todas as condições negociadas.
  • Garantir conformidade com as legislações aplicáveis (fiscais, tributárias).
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos processos, sempre buscando a melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo desejável em Suprimentos, Compras, Administração e Engenharia de produção;
  • Experiência com Compras e negociações;
  • Pacote Office Avançado;
  • Desejável Conhecimento em Ariba/ SAP MM;
  • Desejável Conhecimento em Service Now.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de 15.000 lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

description:
Overview

Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is a worldwide leader in this field. We are actively looking for a Junior level Mechanical Designer Technician to join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office. As part of the Mechanical Group, the Mechanical Engineer Designer will have experience with solid bulk conveyance systems, hydraulic modelling and design of liquid bulk transmission systems, as well as utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems. Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, ENR has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Prepare a variety of designs from agricultural bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • Prepare designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • Perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Prepare design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • Design piping to support projects such as liquid bulk terminals and utilities, including piping design using Plant 3D or similar software
  • Generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • Assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

We draw from the world’s best and brightest, regardless of geographic, cultural, or institutional background. title: OPERADOR(A) ACIARIA II
description:
Gerdau Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Gerdau Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). title: Amazon Logistics Station Leader, Amazon Logistics
description:
DESCRIPTION

At Amazon we treat every single day like its day one. And we never sit still while we do it. Are you up for crafting solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today?

Then we have the opportunity for you! We’re seeking a Delivery Station Manager to join our Amazon Logistics team in Rio de Janeiro - RJ. You’ll operate out of one of our dynamic Delivery Stations: they are at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing Operations and Logistics network: they’re where we sort and process our parcels.

As a Delivery Station Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, supportive leadership for the teams you lead. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves and getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership is key to success in this role: you’ll tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of the role is to lead on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you lead. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Your role will be pivotal in the overall management, control, organization and direction of the Delivery Station. Your responsibilities will include, amongst others:

  • Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting and inspiring a culture of safety on-site;
  • Become proficient on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within Delivery Stations, such as 5S audits;
  • In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll handle meaningful data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis;
  • Therefore, you’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure an excellent customer experience;
  • Partnering closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels;
  • Implement progressive process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Brazil Amazon Logistics network.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Employee and performance management experience;
  • Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams;
  • Expertise in two or more production or supply chain areas, with an impressive track record in a similar, dynamic logistics, distribution or manufacturing environment;
  • Ability to organize details, establish and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate
  • Advanced level in Excel (vlookup, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros);
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and holidays;
  • Fluent Portuguese and basic English;

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Completed master’s degree or MBA; Experience with Kaizen and Lean methodologies and related techniques;
  • Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations;

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura.

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Um retrato do seu dia

Desempenha funções de operação dos equipamentos e sistemas da Planta Termelétrica sob situações normais ou de contingência. Responsável diretamente pelos seguintes setores: planta de água de desmineralização, planta de água de dessalinização, caldeira auxiliar, sistema de redução de pressão de gás natural, produção de água potável, sistema de descarte de efluentes da planta, sistema de combate a incêndio.

Realiza monitoramento da qualidade da produção de água desmineralizada, dessalinizada, efluentes, potável e água de circulação da torre de resfriamento. Deve ser capaz de realizar análises químicas básicas, como verificação de cloro, pH, cor, turbidez e fornecer suporte a equipe laboratorial para coleta de amostras. Fazem cumprir os procedimentos de saúde e segurança da Planta sem concessões dando suporte na realização das atividades de manutenção, fazendo testes e após a finalização da manutenção confirmando que o equipamento se encontra disponível para operação;

A equipe de operações Siemens Energy é responsável pelo funcionamento correto e seguro do complexo termelétrico de GNA com capacidade de 3 GW de geração com possibilidade de expansão. Na Siemens Energy, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa de tecnologia de energia. Nossa equipe global está comprometida em tornar a energia sustentável, confiável e acessível uma realidade, expandindo os limites do que é possível. Mantemos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que apoiarão nosso foco em descarbonização, novas tecnologias e transformação energética.

title: Designer, Marketing
description:
About Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Designer, you’ll help shape the evolution of Darkroom’s brand, website, and digital user experience, from case study pages and service modules to asset selection and overall site identity. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Team Design Lead, crafting visual assets and layouts in tools like Figma and Framer to strengthen our digital presence. Collaborating cross-functionally with the marketing team, you’ll bring our brand to life through thoughtful web design, compelling case studies, and high-impact marketing assets.

In this role, you’ll drive the creation of a consistent and scalable design system that reinforces Darkroom’s brand presence, building best-in-class digital experiences that are both visually stunning and conversion-optimized. You’ll ensure our web touchpoints reflect our creative standards while producing marketing creative that aligns with strategy and drives measurable impact.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal and Brazil.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Design & Brand System

  • Create marketing assets across paid media, organic, and social that are deeply aligned with the Darkroom brand system.

  • Maintain quality, consistency, and visual excellence across all external-facing materials.

  • Contribute to and maintain our Figma-based design system to ensure design scalability and cohesion.

  • Translate marketing objectives into design deliverables that support performance goals and strategic outcomes.

Website & Digital Experience

  • Design new case study pages, service modules and marketing content across our website.

  • Help shape user journeys and design for conversion, user clarity, and seamless experience across devices.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to ensure design aligns with storytelling and brand experience.

  • Design visually engaging email layouts in Figma for newsletters and outbound campaigns.

Framer & No-Code Development

  • Build and deploy high-quality, responsive website pages in Framer , including interaction design and animations.

  • Handle transitions, micro-interactions, and component responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

  • Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Continuously optimize site performance (speed, responsiveness) and contribute to A/B testing frameworks.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • Have 3-4+ years of experience in web, brand, or marketing design, ideally within a fast-paced creative environment or agency.

  • Possess a strong portfolio that showcases website layout, interactive design, and marketing collateral.

  • Are fluent in Figma, including use of components, auto layout, and systemized design workflows.

  • Have hands-on experience with Framer or similar no-code web platforms.

  • Understand UX principles, responsive behavior, animation basics, and component logic.

  • Are proactive, organized, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of accountability.

  • Think strategically and can tie visual design decisions to performance and brand goals.

  • Can communicate design intent clearly for development hand-off and collaborate with engineers when needed.

Marketing Team Requirements

  • You understand how Marketing affects consumer psychology and behavior and you apply these principles to your design.

  • A self-starter with strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset

  • You are self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables

  • You understand how to turn ideas and discussions into actionable next steps.

  • You have a proven track record of collaborating with developers or engineers, and understand how to document your designs for development hand-off.

What it's like to work at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

Somos a Eletrobras, empresa líder em geração e transmissão de energia elétrica no Brasil e na América Latina. Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Planejamento e Controle de Projetos para liderar a estruturação, padronização e implantação de metodologias de planejamento integrado e controle junto ao portfólio de projetos da empresa, atuando de forma matricial junto às equipes de desenvolvimento e implantação de projetos.

  • Garantir a qualidade e assertividade dos cronogramas, orçamentos e forecasts;
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento e controle;
  • Coordenar a interface com áreas técnicas, suprimentos, contratos, meio ambiente, engenharia e implantação, assegurando alinhamento estratégico.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completo em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento e controle de projetos de infraestrutura, com experiência em projetos no setor de energia (Geração e Transmissão);
  • Conhecimento em metodologia LPS - Last Planner System;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento (Primavera P6, MS Project, etc.) e de análise de dados;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica e capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis da organização.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, IPMA, etc.);
  • Experiência com projetos de geração de energia renovável;
  • Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.

Na Eletrobras, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida dos nossos profissionais também fazem parte da Nossa Energia. Por isso, estamos empenhados em oferecer um ambiente de trabalho que valorize o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, disponibilizando benefícios que promovem o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o atendimento às necessidades dos nossos times. title: Executive Tournament Director
description:
Executive Tournament Director

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

THE POSITION

The Executive Tournament Director, under the guidance of FIFA’s Chief Women’s Football Officer will be responsible for leading the team in Brazil tasked with the successful delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The Executive Tournament Director will represent FIFA in Brazil as the primary lead on all tournament related matters in close consultation and collaboration with the CBF, the Brazilian Government, State Governments, local authorities and the Brazilian Football stakeholders. In particular, the Tournament Director will ensure that the strategy, objectives and operational milestones for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 are achieved in a timely manner, within the agreed budgets and in accordance with all FIFA and Brazilian laws, rules and regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Executive Tournament Director will be directly responsible for all administrative, commercial, financial, legal, communication and reporting matters related to the tournament guided by and in close collaboration with the relevant FIFA Chief Officers and the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will oversee and support the work of the Executive Operations Director to ensure that all operational milestones are delivered to a high standard, within agreed timeframes and within targeted financial parameters.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will also serve as a key representative and spokesperson for the event in Brazil, effectively engaging with stakeholders, participants, and media to promote its mission and values in close collaboration with the Chief Women’s Football Officer and Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will form part of the FWWC2027 Senior Leadership Team together with the FIFA Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup and the FIFA27 Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring effective delivery from all Departments and key functional areas involved in the tournament delivery in close collaboration with the Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring seamless collaboration and reporting into the FIFA Leadership.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in leading roles in sports event management and delivery.
  • Proven track record in international event delivery with clear achievement of KPIs on budget, event objectives and operational milestones.
  • Experience in working with the Brazilian Federal and State Governments.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Clear experience in managing multi-million-dollar event budgets.
  • Experience in managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to effectively monitor employees’ organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Have the following strengths: high energy levels, entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Competent IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes (project management certification such as PRINCE2 or PMP an advantage).
  • Experience and knowledge of the local culture and political structures in Brazil.
  • Experience of working in football is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\u2019s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Expert 3: Forest management and Conservation Expert with national experience

Posted on: 29 Aug, 2025 Application by: 10 Sep, 2025 Project status: Tender Project title: Action4Forests – Improve conditions for access to and implementation of REDD+ in Brazil

Period of project: December 2025- Jun 2027 Duration of assignment: 18 months Country: Brazil Job code: 38948

The Action4Forests project is designed to enhance Brazil's capacity to implement effective REDD+ (Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation) strategies, focusing on the Amazon region. Coordinated by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) , in close collaboration with the Brazilian Ministry of the Environment and Climate Change (MMA) and the National Development Bank (BNDES) , this initiative aims to improve access to and the effective implementation of climate finance for forest protection. Running from 2024 to 2028 , the project supports Brazil’s ambitious goal of reducing deforestation, conserving forests, and generating carbon credits through jurisdictional REDD+ programs. Key activities include strengthening governance structures at both subnational and national levels, facilitating access to carbon markets, and empowering Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (IPLC) to actively participate in REDD+ processes. The project is structured around three main outputs:

  • Action4Governments : Enhancing the capacity of subnational governments to access and implement financial resources for forest protection.
  • Action4People : Strengthening IPLC-led organizations, particularly women-led groups, to access finance for forest conservation and carbon market engagement.
  • Action4Funds : Supporting the strategic positioning of the Amazon Fund and other financial mechanisms in alignment with evolving carbon market legislation, focusing on gender-sensitive, sustainable forest financing.
  • Work location is Rio de Janeiro, Brasilia or other locations in the Amazon Region, Brazil.
  • Implementation of Output 1, 2 and 3 activities in close consultation with the GIZ team.
  • Proactively coordinate activities and seek synergies between Outputs 1, 2 and 3.
  • Coordination with relevant public, private and civil society partners in close consultation with GIZ.
  • Coordination with the Expert Pool.
  • Support Implementation of activities defined in the Project´s Annual Operational Plan and herewith contributing to the fulfillment of the Project´s GIZ/BMZ indicators.
  • Participatory development and adaptation of gender sensitive approaches.

Qualifications

  • Education/training: University degree in one the following interdisciplinary fields: forestry / forest science / ecology / geography / sustainable development / environmental economics or comparable related field
  • Language: Knowledge of English B2 level (5 out of 10 points) and Portuguese C2 (5 out of 10 points), in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages
  • General professional experience: 7 years of professional experience in the field of sustainable forest management and project implementation (including planning, coordination, and execution of forest-related initiatives aimed at biodiversity conservation, ecosystem restoration, and sustainable use of forest resources)
  • Specific professional experience: 5 years of professional experience in the development and implementation (equal weight) of forest carbon projects
  • Professional experience in the country/ region of assignment: 5 years of professional experience in the Brazilian Amazon
  • Experience in the field of development cooperation: 3 years of experience in development cooperation projects
  • Other: 3 years of professional experience in sustainable forest management with IPLC

Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organisations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About the Job:

Are you interested in building web crawlers harnessing the Zyte platform, which powers crawls of over 3 billion pages a month?

Do you like working in a company with a strong open source foundation?

Zyte is looking for Software Engineers to join our Delivery team to work on web crawler development with Scrapy, our flagship, open source project.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain Scrapy web crawlers.
  • Leverage the Zyte platform and our open source projects to perform distributed information extraction, retrieval and data processing
  • Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues with distributed crawling at scale
  • Help identify, debug and fix problems with open source projects, including Scrapy

Zyte’s platform and Delivery offerings have been growing tremendously over the past couple of years but there are a lot of big projects waiting in the pipeline, and in this role you would be a key part of that process. Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of software development experience in Python.
  • Solid Python knowledge.
  • Familiarity with Linux/UNIX, HTTP, HTML, Javascript and Networking.
  • Good communication in written and spoken English
  • Availability to work full time.

Bonus points for:

  • Scrapy experience is a big plus.
  • Familiarity with techniques and tools for crawling, extracting and processing data (e.g. Scrapy, NLTK, pandas, scikit-learn, mapreduce, nosql, etc).
  • Proficient English

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

35 days paid holidays

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA
description:
Overview

Grade: P-5

Salary - Annually: Step I - 101,540.00 USD

Post Adjustment - Annually: 30,563.54 USD

Contractual Agreement: Staff - Professional Post

Job Posting: September 4, 2025

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Disclaimer & Application Details

  • This vacancy notice may be used to fill other similar positions at the same grade and level.

  • All applicants are required to complete an online profile to be considered for this post.

  • Candidates will be contacted only if they are under serious consideration.

  • If selected for interview, provide scanned copies of required degrees/certificates. PAHO considers official qualifications from accredited institutions as recognized by WHED/IAU/UNESCO, CHEA, and NCES.

  • Assessment of credentials can be performed via listed sources: World Higher Education Database (WHED), Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and College Navigator (NCES).

  • Links (plain text): whed.net, chea.org, nces.gov.

  • Any appointment/extension is subject to PAHO Staff Regulations, Staff Rules and e-Manual.

  • Maintaining high standards of integrity and accountability in professional and personal activities.

  • Promoting a work environment free from harassment, discrimination, and abusive behavior. Background checks will be conducted.

  • Zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse; wrongdoing may lead to termination and legal action.

title: Senior Fund Accountant - Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You'll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain . Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to .

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies , Fast Company's Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies . We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S. , a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work .

Interested in data privacy? Check out our policies on Privacy and CA Candidate Privacy.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer

Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure DevOps practices, raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a model-driven approach, whether on-premise or on public clouds.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes clusters, and applications for customers across both physical and public cloud estates. We identify and address incidents, monitor and observe applications, anticipate potential issues, and enable product refinement to ultimately achieve high-quality standards in our open source portfolio.

To succeed in this role, you need to have a strong background in Linux, Python, networking, and knowledge of how clouds work. Your work will encompass the entire stack, from bare-metal networking and kernel up to Kubernetes and open source applications. You can expect to be trained in our core technologies like OpenStack, Kubernetes, security standards, open source products like Kubeflow, Kafka, OpenSearch, databases, and many others.

Automation for us is a software engineering problem that we approach with a scientific mindset to bring operations at scale, driven by metrics and code.

Location: Globally remote role

Role

We deploy and run OpenStack, Kubernetes, storage solutions, and open source applications, applying DevOps practices.

To become a member of our team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from bare metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in operations with mission-critical services for global brand-name customers.

As a member of the team, you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure.

What we are looking for in you

  • Degree in software engineering or computer science
  • Python software development experience
  • Operational experience in Linux environments
  • Experience with Kubernetes deployment or operations
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Bonus skills

  • Familiarity with OpenStack deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with public cloud deployment or operations
  • Familiarity with private cloud management

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Every 6 months compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet your colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
